performance_case.causal_mechanism: Research throughput is constrained by immutable evidence clocks and prerequisite chains. Preserving the lawful lane with the shortest deterministic time to first falsifiable mechanism evidence should reduce learning latency without relaxing predictive or economic gates.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch may inspect only the exact listed contracts, accepted results and frozen Manager status snapshot. It cannot inspect outcomes, refresh server state, estimate alpha, create a source or strategy, change a gate, register a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy, change canonical state or schedule, or perform any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. No ranked lane has a matched-capital economic ledger in this audit, so all strategy path risk and drawdown effects remain MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A deterministic lane ranking prevents Local capacity from being spent on the closed public-source branch, the carry lane blocked behind R2, or long-latency post-shock work while the 14-day R2 inventory is the earliest bounded mechanism screen. It preserves R1 and post-shock as independent slower evidence rather than deleting them.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The audit itself cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL. Its research value is reducing time to a valid positive or negative mechanism conclusion by assigning near-term attention to the shortest currently authorized evidence path and explicitly retaining every economic claim as MISSING_PROOF.
